en.hubeali: Ahmad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Lays Al Murady who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the printed clothes, ‘Can the man Ihraam himself in it?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. But rather, it is the blended (with silk) which is disliked’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Hilal who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a cloth which is dyed with al-‘Usfur, then washed, and I wear it while I am in the state of Ihram.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, because al-‘Usfur is not of perfumes but I dislike your wearing something that makes you look unusual in the eyes of people.’”
